scope: bounded extracted concept graph for docs/FV_INVERSE_PROBLEM.md and README.md lines 83-93

nodes.label: Original 20-minute inverse problem J
nodes.summary: Find an eligible local minimum of the original robust regularized analysis cost over the physically and numerically valid domain; no global or domain-membership certification is claimed.

nodes.label: 26 normalized controls and 13 fixed outer parameters
nodes.summary: Controls are 20 field, five streamfunction, and one growth component. Parameters are 12 observation values and external background beta; beta differs from gradient-mixture vartheta.

nodes.label: Whitened point-dBZ observation likelihood
nodes.summary: The objective samples dBZ at fixed bilinear point locations, standardizes and same-time whitens residuals, then sums pseudo-Huber costs with the identity control prior.

nodes.label: Terminal +180-minute forecast score E
nodes.summary: E is the 4x5 terminal-grid dBZ MSE at 12,000 seconds absolute, 10,800 seconds after the last observation; it is separate from J.

nodes.label: Single Q=0 active-face search hypothesis
nodes.summary: Qy[4,3]=0 guides one bounded search; it is not a permanent physical constraint or a truth-generation condition. The current endpoint remains unqualified.
